remediation.hybrid_merge: Remote Supabase results are deduplicated, reserved, and interleaved with local KOSHA results under the limit; mixed results report hybrid-local-supabase.
remediation.policy_boundary: Canonical SIF title, domain-control, alias, operational metadata, and relevance policy now live in safety-reference-policy; client is pure re-export and server retains IO.
remediation.evidence_roles: KOSHA supporting provenance and directEligible remain explicit; supporting KOSHA is not classified as DB direct evidence.
remediation.item_type: Local results require exact technical itemType matching; sif-case never serves the local corpus and regulations do not return guidelines.
remediation.streaming_limit: Opened JSONL descriptors are fstat-checked during and after every streamed chunk, including post-open growth.
remediation.provenance: local-tag/local-ranked/local-hybrid and ranked provenance are preserved in search results and DB harness source counts.
remediation.fixtures: Default harness fixtures are synthetic temp snapshots; real v3 tests are conditional and read-only.

parallel_run.reason: A prior expanded Vitest invocation used the default parallel worker behavior and was interrupted because this worktree has known OOM risk. It is not used as evidence.
